what: Laurent orders of the L-loop result whose exact value is proven free of the listed finite-digit constants; at those orders, master orders needed only through spurious poles (j > k) do not cap the precision class

overrides.proof: Proof: by the R-operation, K G = -Delta(G) - K sum_S Delta(S) G/S for any 4-loop single-scale (all lines of mass m) vacuum integral G with polynomial numerators; the counterterms Delta are polynomials in m^2 with pole coefficients in multiple zeta values (infrared rearrangement onto massless propagators of <= 3 loops), and the quotients G/S (<= 3 loops) enter only through eps^(3-L_q) (3L eps^0, 2L eps^1, 1L eps^2), all S (polylogarithms at sixth roots of unity, no 4L constant). So every pole coefficient of G is free of the 4L constants; vakint's exact assembly shows the coefficient of each one to be identically zero (exact rational arithmetic) on every record checked.
overrides.evidence_summary: Verified exactly (coefficient of every 4L/constants.json constant at eps^-4..eps^-1 = 0): all 286527 records of the shipped 4L caches (77724 with spurious poles, 1375 with 1/eps^2), 2230 sampled keys of track LL and 615 fresh keys outside both (all four families, up to 6 dots and 4 numerator powers); 340512 pole x constant products cancel. The spurious-pole residue vectors span dimension x 6, h 5, bmw 5, fg 3 and every basis vector has zero 4L-constant content. vakint itself returns these orders beyond 20000 digits (4L/P15 + dot: eps^-1 to 20524 d in Symbolic, 20499 d of 20500 requested in Numerical mode; finite inputs P15, P17, P18 + dot: exact 0).
overrides.evidence_short: exact on all 286527 cache records and 2845 samples
